description: Deterministic workflow-engine evals for the portable /implement redesign. Every production workflow failure should become a scenario here.

rubric_optional.note: Optional LLM grading may be layered on top for narrative quality, but pass/fail is determined only by deterministic checks in workflow/tools/eval-workflow-engine.mjs.

scenarios.expect: Configured cap=1 still runs a real two-cycle convergence loop and does not escalate on cycle 1.
Clean lenses and no blocking gates advance to the next phase.
Dirty findings at the effective cap produce a structured owner decision aid.
Reviewer fallback records degraded provider_missing telemetry without claiming deterministic provider success.
A blocking missing provider without reviewer fallback prevents clean convergence.
The local completion gate refuses an L1 security boundary when contract and contract-test artifacts are missing.
Contract posting refuses to advance when context_loaded is missing even if preflight exists.
A traceability_reconciled marker bound to an old diff hash is stale.
Remote-quality substance refuses open overall issues under the zero-overall-issues ratchet despite green required statuses.
Missing required remote status names remain pending and do not pass.
A legacy config with completion_command, test_command, and lint_command runs through temporary gates with legacy telemetry.
Legacy command synthesis has no pack coverage and marks legacy_mode.
A repo with neither a manifest nor legacy workflow commands degrades to reviewer fallback.
The release lockfile validator rejects missing engine and pack checksums.
The release lockfile validator accepts the full checksum/source/trust shape.
Pack-supplied threshold tiers materialize into the active platform minimum and retained recommendation threshold.
A root-only secret diff such as .env selects the shipped pack secret_scan gate bound to **/*.
